summary: Two climbers fell over 100 feet from Wind Ridge, Wind Tower, Eldorado Canyon, when belay anchor failed; one fatality, one severe injuries; RMRG response.
location: Wind Tower, Eldorado Canyon (Wind Ridge route)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff
notes: Anchor (girth-hitched cordelette) failed, pulling both climbers off; survivor in 20s hospitalized with extensive injuries, then airlifted to Denver; deceased in 30s pronounced at ~6:11pm.; Merged 2 reports (parts: aac, news-2020-2023); date per both sources. Boulder Weekly profile of Aubrey Runyon identifies her as the witness/initial responder: reports ~130-ft fall from Wind Tower, survivor with severe leg injury, second climber dead on impact.
